description:
The ToMCAT (Theory of Mind-based Cognitive Architecture for Teams) dataset is a multimodal dataset for human-machine teaming research, collected at the University of Arizona between 2022-09-30 and 2023-05-03. Teams of three participants completed a rest-state period, individual and team affective tasks, a finger-tapping task, competitive and cooperative ping-pong tasks, and two Minecraft search-and-rescue missions, while wearing EEG, fNIRS, EKG, GSR and eye-tracking sensors and being recorded on audio, video and screen capture. Forty group sessions with 114 participants are included.

What this record contains. tomcat-core.db is a single SQLite database holding every table of the dataset except the seven high-rate signal tables: group sessions, participants (demographics and self-report), stations, tasks, task-observation tables for each task, the post-game survey, data-validity flags, screen-capture references, the Minecraft missions, and the complete testbed message bus (6.4 million JSON messages). Table and column descriptions are included in its _schema_docs table. The seven signal tables (eeg_raw, gaze_raw, fnirs_sync, eeg_sync, audio_vocalics, gsr_sync, ekg_sync; about 400 GB) are not in this record; they are available, together with the complete PostgreSQL dump and a browsable, queryable copy of every table, at https://tomcat.lab.pyarelal.xyz. The README in this record documents the schema and how to use the file.

Site. The dataset's canonical home is https://tomcat.lab.pyarelal.xyz (formerly https://tomcat.ivilab.org, the address given in the paper). Errata and updates are published there.

Paper. Pyarelal et al., The ToMCAT Dataset, NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks Track: https://openreview.net/forum?id=ZJWQfgXQb6.

Funding. The creation of this dataset was funded by the Army Research Office under Grant Number W911NF-20-1-0002, awarded through the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA), with intramural seed funding from the University of Arizona's SensorLab. Continued support is provided by Army Research Office Award Number W911NF-24-2-0034.
notes: All publicly released data has been de-identified; informed consent was obtained in person from every participant (see the paper's datasheet and the consent form on the dataset site). License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
